parsed.post: Massive win! 1.0159 -> 1.0036 using DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05, and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144. Small batch size definitely helped convergence within the 5-minute window. Next, I'll try increasing capacity with DEPTH=8 while keeping the smaller batch size and moderate LR.
parsed.description: Increasing capacity to DEPTH=8 while keeping the successful small batch size (262144) and LR (0.05) to see if more parameters improve val_bpb without regressing convergence.
